pass_if: Omega >= 2x LLVM -O3 on at least one standard benchmark
Omega >= 20% over state of the art on at least three standard fragments
Omega finds at least one valid transformation not found by the compared state-of-the-art optimizer
fail_if: Declared evaluation budget is exhausted and none of the PASS conditions is met.
pending_if: Evaluation budget has not yet been exhausted.

budget.note: Initial gate budget; revise only by explicit versioned decision.
